Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.76 per share.
Revenue guidance of $23.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2021.
Our cloud segment grew 17% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 79 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $13.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Revenue guidance of $23.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
